visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 at least starts with the correct array/target and eventually highlights 45 at index 7 and shows the right O(log n) comparison, whereas Lesson 2 repeatedly uses incorrect arrays/values, unsorted data, wrong comparisons like 45 > 56, garbage labels, and mismatched found-index visuals.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 1 includes a concrete, wired quiz gate after act_found with a real question, options, and correct answer, whereas Lesson 2 has no gate specs or plan available, so it provides no functioning checkpoint.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 1 has clear, natural narration with appropriate pacing cues and no read-aloud defects, while Lesson 2 is more compressed and contains the garbled phrase “Too big cried,” which would sound unnatural in audio.

sync.rationale: Lesson 1 at least provides visual cues that mostly occur near the narrated references despite some early or un-narrated transitions, while Lesson 2 provides no beat/timing cue data at all, making its visual-narration synchronization unsupported and worse for this dimension.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 more accurately and pedagogically builds binary search through low/high/mid pointer updates, index calculations, and a halving-to-O(log n) explanation, while Lesson 2 is correct but much more compressed and omits important details like exact mid indices, pointer updates, and the logarithmic derivation.

polish.rationale: Lesson 2 is visually more centered, legible, cohesive, and cinematic despite some garbled labels/typos, while Lesson 1 is repeatedly off-center with huge empty space, overlapping text, cut-off labels, visible undefined values, and cluttered/broken layout elements.

aggregator.explanation: Lesson 1 is the clear overall winner: five of six agents preferred it, including high-confidence wins for visual accuracy, interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and concept accuracy. These dimensions indicate Lesson 1 is substantially more correct, better narrated, more pedagogically complete, and includes a functioning quiz checkpoint. Lesson 2 only wins polish, albeit with high confidence, due to stronger visual composition and cinematic presentation; however, that advantage is outweighed by its major accuracy issues, missing interactivity, unsupported synchronization, and compressed conceptual treatment.
